card.name: One before week or dose level
card.fires_on: The word one (or 1) just before week, and the word dose just before level, in dosing instructions. It also fires on this before manual page.

modes.label: One before week
modes.description: The number one or 1 right before the word week in timing phrases.
modes.example: Begin varenicline tablets dosing<< one>> week before this date.

modes.label: Dose before level
modes.description: The word dose after reduce by one, right before level.
modes.example: consider dose reduction by one<< dose>> level.

modes.label: This before manual page
modes.description: The word manual in a man-page opening, just before page.
modes.example: DESCRIPTION This<< manual>> page gives a brief introduction to SMTP mail

card.writes: It favors a singular unit noun such as layer, step, section or page next, and discourages plural forms.
card.plain: It marks spots where a single unit word like week, level or page is about to come next.
